# Dexter

> Dexter by FLOCK4H is a standalone Solana trading terminal for Pump.fun and PumpSwap, with creator research, token creation, migration-aware routing and position recovery.

Canonical source: https://github.com/FLOCK4H/Dexter
This index covers the GitHub repository and its packaged source. The included native binding supports Windows x64, CPython 3.10+, verified on Python 3.12. Normal installation needs Python and internet access; Rust and an adjacent Mamba checkout are not required. Initial mode is simulate, with mainnet transaction sending locked.

## Installation and use

- [Download and install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FLOCK4H/Dexter/main/docs/install.md): Canonical Git clone or ZIP download, Windows setup, local configuration, readiness checks, and troubleshooting.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FLOCK4H/Dexter/main/README.md): Product overview, supported platform, terminal navigation, execution modes and configuration.
- [Public configuration template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FLOCK4H/Dexter/main/.env.example): Launch, wallet, RPC, database and risk settings; never substitute real secrets into documentation.
- [Command reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FLOCK4H/Dexter/main/docs/commands.md): Runtime, positions, create, analysis, replay, export and database commands.

## Working on the repository

- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FLOCK4H/Dexter/main/AGENTS.md): Setup commands, verification, source map and contribution constraints.
- [Market binding maintenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FLOCK4H/Dexter/main/bindings/README.md): Pinned native source, checksums, supported wheels and market-update workflow.
- [Project metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FLOCK4H/Dexter/main/pyproject.toml): Python requirements, dependencies, version, entry points and canonical project URLs.

## Optional

- [Issues](https://github.com/FLOCK4H/Dexter/issues): Report installation or runtime problems with credentials redacted.
- [CI](https://github.com/FLOCK4H/Dexter/actions): Windows dependency, binding and offline-test checks.
